type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. Owned by the Windows State Manager; MTWindows is a Client publishing events in a domain it does not own.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: When the sender published this message, ISO-8601 UTC.

stateKey.description: Which named state to assert, from the Manager's hand-authored configuration. The content of the state never crosses the wire; an unknown key reports on window.config-rejected.

WindowApplyState.description: Assert a named, hand-authored room state — an assertion of desired state, never a deletion. Addressed to the Windows State Manager; no target segment, the store is room-wide.
